item.title: MJR Morning Brief — September 22, 2026
item.description:
From Media Jobs Report, this is your Morning Brief. A new study from WPP Media, System1 and TikTok finds creator ads work better when brands get to the point early. Mentioning the advertiser in the first two seconds — and using humor, storytelling or other entertaining elements — can significantly boost brand recognition and recall. The findings could also apply to podcast host reads and radio endorsements.
Riley Green is celebrating his new album, That’s Just Me, with an iHeartCountry Album Release Party Wednesday night. The special features a conversation with Green and a live performance, airing nationwide on iHeartCountry stations and streaming on YouTube starting at 7 p.m. Pacific.
Local Media Association says the Economic Opportunity Lab has released a free playbook for local newsrooms. The resource draws on a yearlong project involving 48 newsrooms and 10 NBC and Telemundo stations, offering a framework for using data to report on economic opportunity. For more information, log on to the Local Media Association website at local media dot org.
CNN is bringing Farm Aid back to television Saturday night. The four-hour live broadcast from Virginia Beach begins at 7 Eastern, featuring Willie Nelson, Neil Young, John Mellencamp, Dave Matthews, Margo Price and more. John Berman and Laura Coates will anchor CNN’s coverage.
The nominees are out for the 2026 Latin GRAMMY Awards. Karol G, Rosalía, Mon Laferte, Jorge Drexler and Milo J are among the artists represented in major categories including Record, Album and Song of the Year. The awards are set for November 12, with the complete nominee list available at Media Jobs Report.
Sinclair is expanding The National News Desk, adding a new 5 p.m. edition in 12 markets and daytime half-hour newscasts in 21 markets. The expansion began September 21 and brings additional national news programming to Sinclair stations throughout the afternoon and early evening. The National News Desk now airs on 90 stations nationwide.
NBCUniversal Local’s Clear The Shelters campaign helped more than 135,000 pets find new homes this year while raising nearly half a million dollars for animal shelters. More than 100 NBC and Telemundo stations participated. Since 2015, the campaign has helped nearly 1.5 million pets get adopted nationwide.
Early Bird registration is now open for Country Radio Seminar 2027. Save $100 for the two-day-only rate is $699 through September 23 before increasing to $799. CRS returns to Nashville March 17 through 19 with three days of education, networking, industry research and live entertainment. Register through Eventbrite
